text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Ramonu. Is it alright for you to just 
be standing around here?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Not really. Just that the Mejiro folks 
were looking for you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Right. I wonder what business she has.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: According to them, it's your birthday.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, come to think of it, you're right. 
If you'll excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, I almost feel sorry for those 
guys.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I wonder about that. Right now, I'm aiming 
to pull ahead of them, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...My, how passionate. I'd best run along 
before I melt away.
